svg.aria-label: Inside Cadus: Privacy guard: Hides patient identifiers before anything leaves the device.; Safety review: Every clinical answer is checked for doses and red flags.; Deep Dive: Plans the question, searches PubMed step by step, writes a cited report.; Rx Safety Check: Typed, photographed or PDF scripts: doses, interactions, allergies.; Consult Translator: Two-way doctor–patient interpreting in 13 Indian languages.; Cadus Crew: 20 ready-made assistants or your own, with knowledge files and @mentions.
